postal_system.assignment_rule: The Government postcode guide lists eight active codes: MSR1110, MSR1120, MSR1210, MSR1230, MSR1250, MSR1310, MSR1330 and MSR1350. The UPU June 2026 addressing sheet confirms MSR plus four digits and the code hierarchy. The dated guide and a current government address do not establish a current complete versioned assignment, alias, validity, correction, exception and explicit non-area denominator.
postal_system.geometry_rule: The reviewed Government and UPU sources publish prose locality and post-office coverage, not a Polygon or MultiPolygon dataset, CRS, topology, feature identity, method, confidence or exception model. Parish, locality, street, post-office, route, P.O. box, Point, buffer, hull, cell and model geometry remain independently typed and cannot be relabelled as an official postal area.
postal_system.address_format_rule: Store recipient, organization, premises, street, locality, parish and the integral MSRNNNN postcode separately. Official examples are reference evidence, not production address rows.
postal_system.postal_object_rule: Store post offices, P.O. boxes, routes, organizations, points and other service objects with their real type. A non-area object never becomes a postal Polygon/MultiPolygon without an authoritative relation and reviewed geometry.
postal_system.building_rule: Building display requires a rights-cleared stable civic-address identity, a separately permitted building identity or footprint and an explicit reviewed relation. Postcode containment, locality text, coordinate, parcel, proximity or AGID cell is not an exact address-to-building relation.
postal_system.derived_and_realtime_rule: Derived or virtual geometry requires an explicit competent-authority code-to-source-feature crosswalk, compatible rights, edition, schema, CRS, topology, method, confidence and exception review; it is never silently official.
postal_system.agid_rule: AGID remains an independent spatial index. A versioned crosswalk may relate exact postal evidence and independently licensed context to AGID cells without turning AGID or administrative geometry into Montserrat postal geometry.
postal_system.licence_rule: The Statistics Department open licence is expressly limited to Statistics Department data and does not license Montserrat Postal Service or Physical Planning material by association. The reviewed postal and planning pages publish no compatible postal geometry licence, and UPU copyright/database restrictions apply to UPU material. Public access is reference evidence, not a redistribution grant.
postal_system.jurisdiction_rule: Preserve ISO MS and the separate identities of Montserrat, parishes, postal districts, localities and source features. Do not merge or borrow assignments or geometry from another Caribbean jurisdiction.
postal_system.privacy_rule: Addresses, occupants, organizations, P.O. box holders, buildings, coordinates and query logs may expose household, property or commercial context. Raw personal, customer and land-rights data is excluded.
postal_system.temporal_rule: The Government guide, UPU 06/2026 sheet, current operator page, assignments and geometry are time-dependent. Preserve edition, retrieved_at, valid_from, valid_to, supersession and SHA-256 independently.

stages.definition: Montserrat address-format and postal-source inventory only.
Digest-bound Government of Montserrat and UPU format, eight-code guide, rights-scope and no-proxy evidence.

M2 requires a current complete Montserrat Postal Service release of every integral MSR plus four-digit postcode assignment, alias, validity interval, correction, exception and typed area/non-area object, fixed by retrieval time, edition, stable identity, schema, coverage, exact bytes and SHA-256 under rights compatible with AGID processing, storage, derivation, redistribution and public serving. The Government postcode guide lists eight active codes and prose locality coverage, and the UPU 06/2026 sheet confirms syntax and address placement, but neither supplies a current versioned assignment denominator or postal geometry release. Every drawable current code must reconcile to finite closed valid Polygon/MultiPolygon geometry with official/derived/virtual class, source feature identity, reference date, CRS, topology, method, confidence and exceptions. Parishes, localities, streets, offices, P.O. boxes, routes, organizations, addresses, buildings, Points, buffers, hulls, Voronoi/raster cells, AGID cells and models cannot be promoted without an explicit competent-authority postcode crosswalk and compatible rights. Non-area objects must display their type and reason without a fabricated surface. An approved immutable artifact must drive the real MS API/app, normalize MSR plus four digits, handle loading, no-match, multiple, API failure and invalid geometry, fit and render a translucent fill with clear outline only for eligible real geometry, support clear and re-search, and display selected code, geometry kind, official/derived/virtual class, source, reference date and confidence.

agid_integration.current_scope: MS metadata, official format and guide evidence, rights scope and no-proxy rules only; no real MS Postal Context descriptor is enabled.
agid_integration.enablement_gate: A current complete rights-cleared assignment denominator, immutable geometry artifacts and real MS loader/API/app verification are required.
agid_integration.geometry_rule: Do not manufacture delivery-area polygons from locality or post-office lists. Independently licensed context remains typed and source-qualified.
